Submission of any false information will lead to immediate disqualification of the candidate at any stage of the hiring process. A Consultant will be selected in accordance with the Open Competitive Selection of Individual Consultants method set out in the Procurement Regulations. Eligible candidates shall apply online at SIFC Job Portal i.e., https://jobs.sifc.gov.pk/ within fifteen (15) days of publication of this REOI. Further information can be obtained at the address below during office hours 0900 to 1600 hours PST. open.pn: National Health Support Program
open.bd: Hiring of Consultant for Environmental and Social Safeguard (ESS)
open.tx: REQUEST FOR EXPRESSION OF INTEREST (EOI). For the Hiring of Individual Consultant Services / Environmental & Social Safeguard (ESS) Activity Reference No: PK-NHSP SINDH-582586-CS-INDV Assignment Title: Hiring of Consultant for Environmental and Social Safeguard (ESS) Credit No: IDA 7149-PK The Government of Sindh (Hereinafter Called Borrowers) has received financing from International Development Association (IDA) (The Bank) in the form of credit (hereinafter called credit) the cost of strengthen Primary Healthcare in Sindh. The Program Director, National Health Support Program (NHSP) Health Department, Government of Sindh, intends to apply part of proceeds of the credits for payments to the following Individual Consultant Services to be procured under the project. The Consultant Services to be procured on contract basis are as follows: S.No Name of Post with PPs No. of Positions Qualification Experience & Skills 1 Consultant for Environmental & Social Safeguard (ESS) 01 Master’s degree (or 16 years of Education) in environmental science, engineering, social sciences, public health or a related field. At least 8 years of E&S experience on development programs in Pakistan, including 3 years on Donor-financed operations preferably in health-sector. Working knowledge of the PforR and IPF approach (ESSA, Core Principles, PAP, DLIs, ESMF, ESCP and Environmental and Social Standards) and of Sindh’s environmental, labour and OHS framework. Experience in GRM, stakeholder engagement and SEA/SH. Strong reporting and training skills; English, Urdu and Sindhi preferred; willingness to travel to districts. The Project Management Unit (PMU), National Health Support Program (NHSP) Sindh now invites interested eligible individuals to express their interest against above mentioned Individual Consultant services on Project basis. The ToRs for the position can be seen at www.nhsp.gos.pk Interested applicants must send their “Expression of Interest” (EoI) along with their detailed updated Curriculum Vitae (CV) highlighting qualifications and experience in carrying out similar assignments, for possible checks along with 2 photographs (Passport Size) CNIC, Degrees and Experience certificates to the mentioned below address (in person or by registered mail services) within (14) Days of publication i.e; up to 9th December, 2026. Only eligible shortlisted Consultants will be considered for interview. Individual Consultants will be hired on contract basis up to December, 31, 2027, Late received EoI shall not be entertained. The Procurement shall be carried out in accordance with World Bank Procurement Regulation for IPF Borrowers seventh edition September 2025. Program Director PMU for NHSP-SINDH. Office: Bangalow No. 10/1, Zamzama, Street-II, DHA Phase-V, Karachi – Sindh Contact No. +92 21 37222446 Email: info@nhsp.gos.pk Website: www.nhsp.gos.pk

open.tx: REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST (CONSULTING SERVICES – INDIVIDUAL CONSULTANT SELECTION) Country: Pakistan Name of Project: Digital Economy Enhancement Project (DEEP) Credit No: 7514-PK Assignment Title: DevOps / Cloud Engineer Reference No.: PK-BOI-579478-CS-INDV The Government of Pakistan has received financing from the International Development Association (IDA) toward the cost of Digital Economy Enhancement Project (DEEP) and intendsto apply part of the proceeds for consulting services, which shall be implemented by the SIFC Division Board of Investment (BOI). The consulting services (“the Services”) include professional expertise of “DevOps / Cloud Engineer” at a monthly lump sum remuneration. SIFC Division Board of Investment, being Project Implementing Unit (PIU) intends to hire services of the DevOps / Cloud Engineer for DEEP that can assist the project management in relevant field. The consultant, as an expert in the field, will provide required services maintaining highest degree of integrity and ethical standards. The services of individual consultant shall be initially hired for a period of 12 months initially, extendable subject to performance and approval. The detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment can be accessed from https://invest.gov.pk/careers and https://jobs.sifc.gov.pk/ Board of Investment being project implementing unit invites eligible candidates (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the services as DevOps / Cloud Engineer in Digital Economy Enhancement Project-BOI. Interested Candidates should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the expected Services. The services of individual consultant will be required /hired to assist project team on DEEP “as per ToRs”. The short-listing criteria are based on: (i) Qualification (ii) Experience (iii) Additional Skills. The shortlisted candidates will be required to present their original documents at the time of credential verification meeting. Submission of any false information will lead to immediate disqualification of the candidate at any stage of the hiring process. The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to Section III, paragraphs, 3.14, 3.16, and 3.17 of the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers” September 2023, setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest. A Consultant will be selected in accordance with the Open Competitive Selection of Individual Consultants method set out in the Procurement Regulations. Eligible candidates shall apply online at SIFC Job Portal i.e., https://jobs.sifc.gov.pk/ within fifteen (15) days of publication of this REOI. Further information can be obtained at the address below during office hours 0900 to 1600 hours PST. (Syed Mazhar Ali) Procurement Management Specialist DEEP-BOI SIFC Division Board of Investment, Office# 307, 3 rd Floor, Evacuee Trust Complex, Islamabad PHONE: (051) 9218801

open.tx: REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST (CONSULTING SERVICES) Country: Pakistan Project: Getting Results: Access and Delivery of Quality Education Services in Balochistan (GRADES-B) Project Number: P507512 Assignment Title: Hiring of Consulting Firm for Engagement of a Third-Party Validation (TPV) Firm for Verification of Community-Based School Sites Identified by District Education Groups (DEGs) under GRADES-Balochistan Reference No . PK-PMU-SED GOB-576103-CS-CQS The Government of Balochistan, through the Government of Pakistan, has secured USD $100 Million funded through IDA capital credit financing from the World Bank to implement the Getting Results: Access and Delivery of Quality Education Services in Balochistan (GRADES-B) project. The project is designed to increase girls’ and boys’ enrollment in pre-primary and primary grades, and to improve reading and numeracy proficiency in primary grades, all in project-supported schools. The GRADES-B project aims to address educational disparities in Balochistan by enhancing access, quality, and equity in education. The initiative focuses on foundational literacy and numeracy, increased enrollment, and sustainable systemic reforms. The proposed project is structured around four components to address systemic challenges in the education sector of the province. They focus on improving access to education and enhancing teaching quality, strengthening data-driven accountability, building resilience to climate change , and introducing emergency preparedness mechanisms to minimize disruptions. Project Management Unit (here and after as the Client) intends to apply part of the proceeds to cover eligible payments for hiring the services of Consulting Firm for Engagement of a Third-Party Validation (TPV) Firm for Verification of Community-Based School Sites Identified by District Education Groups (DEGs) under GRADES-Balochistan (here and after as the Consulting Firm). The consulting services (“the Services”) include provision of Engagement of a Third-Party Validation (TPV) Firm for Verification of Community-Based School Sites under GRADES-Balochistan, ensuring full consistency with the TOR’s referred to in this REOI. The Terms of Reference (TOR) for the primary procurement stage for the assignment can be found at the following website: https://pmubesp.gob.pk/ or can be obtained at the Office Address, House # 74-A Chaman Housing Scheme, Airport Road Quetta. The Project Management Unit, Balochistan Education Support Project now invites eligible consulting firms (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services. recentClosed.tx: Country: Islamic Republic of Pakistan Name of Project: Integrated Flood Resilience and Adaptation Project (IFRAP) — Component 2: Strengthening Hydromet and Climate Services Contract Title: Selection of an Individual Customs Clearing and Forwarding Agent Credit / Loan No.: IDA-73330 RFQ / STEP Reference No.: PK-PMD-542126-NC-RFQ 1.1 The Islamic Republic of Pakistan has received financing from the World Bank towards the cost of Strengthening Hydromet and Climate Services under Component-II of the Integrated Flood Resilience and Adaptation Project (IFRAP), and intends to apply part of the proceeds towards payments under a Contract for the selection of a registered Individual Customs Clearing and Forwarding Agent for the clearance of 110 Automatic Weather Stations (AWS) imported under HS Code 9015.8020, comprising Lot-1 (60 AWS, origin Italy) and Lot-2 (50 AWS, origin Slovakia). This procurement will be conducted through the Request for Quotations (RFQ) method, Single-Stage One-Envelope procedure with post-qualification of the recommended Bidder, in accordance with the World Bank Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers (Goods, Works, Non-Consulting and Consulting Services), November 2020, as amended (the “Procurement Regulations”), and is open to all eligible registered Individual Customs Clearing and Forwarding Agents. 1.2 The Project Implementation Unit, Pakistan Meteorological Department (“PIU-PMD” or the “Purchaser”) invites eligible Bidders to submit priced quotations for the entire scope of services described in Section III. Partial quotations covering only part of the scope will be rejected. 1.3 The Bidder must hold a valid Customs Agent License issued by Pakistan Customs and must be registered with the Federal Board of Revenue and with the relevant provincial revenue authority for sales tax on services. Detailed eligibility and qualification requirements are set out in Clauses 2.2 and 2.3. 1.4 The quotation shall be accompanied by all documentary evidence listed in the Bidder’s Checklist at Clause 4.6. A quotation not accompanied by the mandatory documents will be treated as non-responsive. 1.5 Quotations determined to be substantially responsive will be compared on the basis of the Grand Total (Bid Cost inclusive of taxes) stated in Schedule A of Section IV. The Contract will be awarded to the Bidder offering the lowest evaluated total cost for the whole scope, and not on the basis of the price of any individual item. 1.6 Rates shall be quoted only in Pakistan Rupees (PKR) as fixed lump-sum unit rates. Rates quoted as a percentage of the value of the equipment, or on any other ad valorem, indexed or conditional basis, will render the quotation non-responsive. Bidders must read Clause 2.5 (Mandatory Rules for Preparing Schedule A) before completing Section IV. 1.7 Customs duties, taxes and other statutory levies on the imported AWS equipment are excluded from the Agent’s rates. These will be paid directly by the Purchaser to the Government

Contract title : Procurement of DGPS Survey for Green Property Certificate and Registered Documents in DG Khan Division under PULSE Project. Country: PAKISTAN Credit No.: 7041-PK RFB No: PK-BOR PUNJAB-562682-NC-RFB 1. The Project Management Unit-Board of Revenue has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the Punjab Urban Land Systems Enhancement Project and intends to apply part of the proceeds toward payments under the contract for Procurement of DGPS Survey for Green Property Certificate and Registered Documents in DG Khan Division under PULSE Project. 2. The Project Management Unit-Board of Revenue now invites sealed Bids from eligible Bidders for Procurement of DGPS Survey for Green Property Certificate and Registered Documents in DG Khan Division under PULSE Project. 3. Bidding will be conducted through national competitive procurement using a Request for Bids (RFB) Single Stage-One Envelop as specified in the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers -” November 2020, and is open to all eligible Bidders as defined in the Procurement Regulations. 4. The bidding document in English language may be downloaded by interested eligible Bidders from the website https://pulse.gop.pk/. Interested eligible Bidders may obtain further information (if required) from the office of the Procurement Specialist, Project Management Unit, Punjab Urban Land Systems Enhancement (PULSE), Govt. of Punjab, ( Email : pspmupulse@punjab-zameen.gov.pk ). 5. Bids must be delivered to the address below on or before 11.00 a.m. September 02, 2026. Electronic Bidding will not be permitted. Late Bids will be rejected. Bids will be publicly opened in the presence of the Bidders’ designated representatives and anyone who chooses to attend at the address below on September 02, 2026 immediately after the bid submission deadline. All Bids must be accompanied by a Bid-Security The amount and currency of the Bid Security shall be PKR 1,500,000/- in the form CDR or Bank Guarantee issued by a scheduled bank operating in Pakistan. 6. Attention is drawn to the Procurement Regulations requiring the Borrower to disclose information on the successful bidder’s beneficial ownership, as part of the Contract Award Notice, using the Beneficial Ownership Disclosure Form as included in the bidding document. 7. The address(es) referred to above is (are): Procurement Specialist Project Management Unit-Board of Revenue , PULSE. 158-A, Abu Bakar Block, New Garden Town, Lahore, Pakistan. 042-37882061-63 pspmupulse@punjab-zameen.gov.pk https://pulse.gop.pk

The project development objective is to improve flood protection, increase access to water for productive use, and improve water supply service delivery in selected areas of Balochistan. recentClosed.tx: BALOCHISTAN WATER SECURITY AND PRODUCTIVITY IMPROVEMENT PROJECT REQUEST FOR EXPRESSION OF INTEREST FOR THE SELECTION OF ENVIRONMENTAL SPECIALIST /INDIVIDUAL CONSULTANT The Government of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, through the Government of Balochistan (GoB), with support of the World Bank (WB), is implementing the Balochistan Water Security and Productivity Improvement Project (BWSPIP). The project development objective is to improve flood protection, increase access to water for productive use, and improve water supply service delivery in selected areas of Balochistan. It intends to apply part of the funds to cover eligible payments to hire the services of motivated, experienced, and energetic individual to work with the Project Implementation Unit as Environmental Specialist / Individual Consultant. S.No Position Qualification/Experience 1. Environmental Specialist Master’s degree in Environmental sciences, Environmental Management, Natural Resource Management, Environmental Engineering, Chemical Engineering or comparable discipline. Minimum seven (07) years of professional post-qualification working experience in public/private organizations, preferably in the development sector. Knowledge of national and international environmental and social regulations, including environmental and social impact assessments, as required by national/international institutions. Experience working in Balochistan or similar regions, with an understanding of the unique geographic and socio-economic challenges in infrastructure development. Proficiency in local languages and the ability to effectively engage with local communities will be a significant advantage. Familiarity with environmental policies in international donor-funded projects will be an advantage The Government of Balochistan, represented by the Project Director, PIU-BWSPIP (Component-B), now invites eligible individuals to indicate their interest in providing the services. Interested consultants must provide detailed CVs describing that they are qualified to perform the services as per the criteria defined in the document titled “Terms of Reference” , which can be downloaded from the project website by following the link http://www.bwspip-b.org.pk. Eligible candidates who meet the required criteria are encouraged to submit their EOI/CV, along with a cover letter, by 4th September 2026 via email at procurement.bwspip.qwasa@gmail.com. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. The detailed Terms of Reference (ToRs) are available at https://bwspip-b.org.pk/. The Individual Consultant shall be selected in accordance with the World Bank Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers, Procurement in Investment Project Financing – Goods, Works, Non-Consulting and Consulting Services (Fifth Edition, September 2023), under the Selection of Individual Consultants method. Sd/ Project Director PIU-BWSPIP (Component-B) Email: procurement.bwspip.qwasa@gmail.com Address: House No AB-37, Chaman Housing Scheme
